label: H.R. 1642
title: Connecting Small Businesses with Career and Technical Education Graduates Act of 2025
short_title: Connecting Small Businesses with Career and Technical Education Graduates Act of 2025

latest_action.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Small Business and Entrepreneurship.

summary: Connecting Small Businesses with Career and Technical Education Graduates Act of 2025 This bill requires Small Business Development Centers and Women's Business Centers to provide educational information to small businesses about hiring graduates of career and technical education programs. This includes, as appropriate, connecting small businesses with career and technical education programs to assist students and graduates of such programs with identifying career opportunities.
summary_short: Connecting Small Businesses with Career and Technical Education Graduates Act of 2025 This bill requires Small Business Development Centers and Women's Business Centers to provide educational information to small businesses about hiring graduates of career and technical education programs.
